articles.headline: Suicide bombing at Swat police station kills 14, injures over 25
articles.summary: AI summary: A suicide bomber detonated explosives at the gate of Kabal police station in Swat on Sunday as security tried to stop him, killing at least 14 people, mostly police officers, and injuring around 18-25 others during a nearby anti-terrorism protest. No group has claimed responsibility, and authorities have cordoned off the area for investigation.

articles.headline: Electoral rolls shrink by 589,458 in less than two months as ECP removes 1.48m deceased voters
articles.summary: AI summary: Pakistan's electoral rolls contracted by roughly 589,000 voters between May and July as the Election Commission struck about 1.48 million deceased voters from the register, outpacing nearly 895,000 new registrations, with Punjab accounting for the bulk of the net decline.

economic.reason: Routine voter roll maintenance with no direct economic effect.

political.reason: Reflects ordinary administrative data cleanup by the Election Commission rather than a destabilizing event.
